No execution receipt exists for any candidate.

Both candidates target the indefinite-begin animations without altering geometry or timing. The restart-trigger option is the more declarative/minimal incremental change, while the redundant autostart wrapper is duplicative and less clearly supported; no tool execution or receipt is present to verify either beyond the supplied SVG evidence.
